caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display over a dark horizon. A fixed white street lamp glows at left, and faint orange ground lights line the bottom edge. In the upper right, a cluster of yellow-green sparks and, just below-right of it, a cluster of red sparks spread outward into separated points while gradually dimming. A vertical column of bright dots appears partway through beneath the burst, rising through the lower right. In the later view, a brighter white-green core sits beside the red sparks as the dispersed points thin, while the lamp and ground lights remain fixed at the left edge.
